tools.name: description_pin
tools.description: A server can change a tool description after the client approved it; the cheapest structural defense is that every tool description carries its version pin, or an explicit PINNED-UNVERSIONED marker when the tool is deliberately version-free. Pin: PINNED-UNVERSIONED (tool source carries no version header as of 2026-09-25, gala afterparty t49; description quoted verbatim from the docstring body because the headline line contains an em-dash and filed text carries none).
